requirement.statement: The loader SHALL parse InstantCtrlFlow, WorkCtrlFlow and BPCtrlFlow root lists as canonical CtrlFlow statements and MUST reject Tree, action.types, standalone CtrlFlow and public behavior-tree authoring nodes.

case.then: root statements SHALL be preserved in declaration order
loading SHALL fail with stable diagnostics

requirement.statement: The compiler SHALL lower CtrlFlow statements to a rebuildable internal plan and SHALL invoke all referenced code using output = fn(runtime, input, config).

case.given: If with ordered Branches and Otherwise
case.then: the internal plan SHALL preserve first-match and no-op semantics

case.given: Run, Return or predicate code ref
case.then: the runtime SHALL call the exported function with runtime, input and config

requirement.statement: All depa-flows control-flow demos SHALL use only the new public DSL and SHALL pass parser, validator, typecheck and applicable execution tests.
